newsitem.title: GERMANY: Korean moves Frankfurt passenger terminal.
newsitem.headline: Korean moves Frankfurt passenger terminal.

text.p: Korean Air Lines will switch passenger operations at Frankfurt Airport to Terminal 2 from March, airport authority Flughafen Frankfurt Main AG (FAG) said.
The Korean national carrier will use check-in counters made available by the withdrawal of Delta Air Lines services from Frankfurt to six European destinations, FAG said.
FAG was now in negotiations over counter spaces with other airlines on a waiting list who wanted to move from Terminal 1 to Terminal 2, it added.
Thirty-three carriers currently use the second Frankfurt Airport terminal, which opened in 1994.
In Terminal 1, four new or renovated gates in the A finger will be opened in the next few days, FAG said.
This was part of an ongoing 1.14 billion mark modernisation of the terminal up to the year 2000, it added. Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+ 44-171-542-7706 Fax+44-171-542-5017
